::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** June 6 th [1882]  
**From:** Elderfield, Otterbourne, Winchester.  
**Manuscript:** MS Mrs Clare Roels[^1]
:::

My dear [Christabel](people/person_329.qmd)

The elder sister may be a good modification and pray do you – or [FMP](people/person_1160.qmd) invent a love story to work in.[^1]

No Robber appears so do pray write him, also Geo III and the beggar.  I have done a White Ship. There ought I fancy to be about 30, and I have 28 in my eye or written out ie if I take two Whittingtons.

What do you think of the baby Pretender in his nurses’ arms under the Church wall in his mother’s flight?

In haste
your affectionate
C M Yonge

I got [Mrs Argles](people/person_57.qmd) ([Dr Davys](people/person_411.qmd)’ daughter) to tell me over again the story of the Pedigree.  It is all right

---

[^1]: Endorsed in another hand '1882'.

**Note:** *i.e.*, to *The Miz Maze* the novel they were writing in collaboration.  The rest of the letter seems to relate to a different project, however.
